mapper.sql: id, show_id, user_id, order_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, rating, like_count, reply_count, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO show_review (show_id, user_id, order_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, rating, like_count, reply_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{showId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{likeCount}, #{replyCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS username, NULL AS reply_to_username FROM show_review WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_review WHERE show_id = #{showId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status <> 2

SELECT r.id, r.show_id, r.user_id, r.order_id, r.parent_id, r.reply_to_user_id, r.content, r.rating, r.like_count, r.reply_count, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, u.username AS username, u2.username AS reply_to_username FROM show_review r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` u2 ON u2.id = r.reply_to_user_id WHERE r.parent_id = #{parentId} AND r.status <> 2 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_review WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status <> 2
mapper.update: UPDATE show_review SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE show_review SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE show_review SET reply_count = reply_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE show_review SET reply_count = GREATEST(reply_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE show_review SET status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM show_review WHERE show_id = #{showId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 0 AND rating IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_review WHERE show_id = #{showId} AND parent_id IS NULL
